about: A morning newspaper for markets, AI and chips, robotics, space and tech. Hundreds of headlines are boiled down to the stories that matter: coverage from several outlets is merged, there's an AI brief at the top and a “why it matters” line on every story.

features.title: Curated news
features.body: Refreshed through the day, with stories you already saw in earlier editions skipped.

features.title: An AI brief on top
features.body: The day's essentials first, then a “why it matters” line on every story.

features.title: Stock desk
features.body: Forward P/E, quality and valuation scores, and live prices with intraday charts, for big US tech and Indonesian blue chips.

features.title: Portfolio on every device
features.body: Sign in once and your holdings and alerts follow you to your phone, laptop and work PC.

features.title: Price alerts
features.body: Above/below, support breaks and SMA-200 crosses.

features.title: Installable
features.body: Add it to your home screen and it behaves like an app.
